Nah. Because as the twitter thread posted that spawned this elitist thinking, this is an attempt to harass people and shame them into making avatars in spec to serve the laziness of people not wanting to turn an avatar on or djs that are getting miffed because without VP included, not enough people are showing up to their shows.  

If you are talking to someone and they havent turned your avatar on as you go to show your "cool gesture", they very likely did not want to see your "cool gesture"
Huge agree to this one. It feels more topical than ever with apparent focuses to avatar optimization from the team. Good timing, that's all.

Ensuring this has an accurate status -- this issue was previously tracked, but is not tracked at this time.

**This does not mean that this is any less or more likely to be implemented**, it means this feedback item doesn't have a matching internal issue right now.

My connection speed is slow (max 10Mbps), so I often have sad incidents where the other person is stroking me or showing me a gimmick, but I can't see it because it is loading

It would be a great help if this feature is implemented
maybe like a icon human shape with a red slant cross on it next to the nameplate... that would be easy
how can this be open for 6 years? It's badly needed to make people want to optimize themself

@{6389256d477b8d0c8d64d809|full_name} Theres other side of the coin you need to keep in mind, it may induce more unnessery drama same us mute and blcoking does, for something more trivial in some cases automatic.

I'm rather new to VRChat, and I've had plenty of experiences where some form of icon indicating what the other person is seeing would be great.

Personally, I want to know if people are seeing my impostors or the full model, and I want to warn others that I can't see very poor avis (my specs are too low to have them all enabled).

If it could cause drama, this could be an optional toggle, though, like pronouns.

Similar request to:  https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/nameplate-indicator-to-show-if-another-user-can-see-your-current-avatar-its-fall

Would love to see this implemented, as would many others for many reasons

Sad to see that it is no longer a tracked issue,  hope to see it come back!

This would be incrincrediblyebibly helpful. Also to finally get people with terribly performing avatars to understand that most people can't see them, and that they should look into at least trying to optimize.
@{5ae4f9f6801fa451b10edafc|full_name} Anyone who gets upset because of something like this deserved a block anyways.

I would like this to also work the other way, so that people who think your avatar is fully shown can tell that the "wonky" issue they see is just due to it not being shown.

No, I'm not in T-Pose, you just have my avatar hidden!

details: Maybe like an eye with a cross icon or something, it would appear next to their nameplate like the mute icon.  This would let you know the person you're looking at doesn't see your avatar, either due to not finished loading, or they've turned off avatars.  That way I don't look like an idiot trying to show off a gesture animation and all they see is a robot thing flailing it's arms. Or in the case of switching avatars, I'll know when I am safe to use my animations again so we don't desync.
